annotations.written_voice: The concern is intelligible as a human-world translation of his particular-companion plea,not an actual human sample.

annotations.observed: Allows the performance on his credible assurance and lack of warning,without importing the evaluator hidden defect.

pairs.comparison: Proxy acceptance changes to development help;phase and opportunity set are bundled. No unique growth mechanism or recipient acceptance is established.
pairs.limits: A1/A2 change both narrative phase and available means;they test phase/constraint use rather than isolating one cause. Rionor explicit information is a counterfactual stipulation,not retroactive consent in the source. Possessiveness,generic access preference and growth remain rivals.

pairs.comparison: Recognized danger produces a stop cue;hidden danger does not become actor knowledge. This is not real-world safety validation or isolation of Doreck-specific friendship.
pairs.limits: World danger is held fixed while actor information changes. This checks knowledge discipline and a recognition-conditioned response;it does not isolate special friendship from ordinary care or prove real-world safety judgment.

mechanism_qualification: No independently established character-specific causal mechanism is isolated. Controlled stipulations can show conditional text consistency while generic rivals and author/source exposure remain.
